metadata.excluded_sources_statement: Only the authorized public corpus is used for source_refs and textual attestation.

entries.definition_short: Canonical name of the agent defined by the public specification.
entries.definition_operational: Names the agent whose role is to allow restoration only after complete verification and otherwise block, suppress, or isolate persistent context.

entries.definition_short: Agent identifier assigned in the overview table.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the stable identifier for the public specification record of the agent.

entries.definition_short: Document type declared for the public release.
entries.definition_operational: Marks the document as the buyer-facing and self-contained public specification used for semantic extraction.

entries.definition_short: Persistent context subject to restoration control.
entries.definition_operational: Names the persistent state whose restoration is permitted only after complete verification and otherwise remains blocked, suppressed, or isolated.
usage_constraints: Restoration is permitted only after complete verification.

entries.definition_short: Reception log used to prove valid intake and visibility.
entries.definition_operational: Names the reception log used to prove valid intake and to anchor which head is visible and eligible for restoration.

entries.definition_short: Candidate top record or state boundary considered for restoration.
entries.definition_operational: Names the candidate top record or state boundary considered for restoration before accepted visibility and full verification are established.

entries.definition_short: Head made eligible by a valid IRR entry and the visibility rule.
entries.definition_operational: Names the head made eligible by a valid IRR entry and the visibility rule, but not yet the verified head for replay and release.

entries.definition_short: Head fixed for replay and release after the required verification sequence.
entries.definition_operational: Names the head selected after verification, used for replay, release, and evidence binding.

entries.definition_short: Persisted capability or tool configuration state handled separately from restoration.
entries.definition_operational: Names persisted capability or tool configuration state that remains separate from conversational or contextual restoration and requires a separate activation gate and approval path.
usage_constraints: Tool-state remains untrusted and inactive unless a separate activation gate and required approval both succeed.

entries.definition_short: Primary persistent input used as a restoration source.
entries.definition_operational: Names the append-only ledger provided as a primary input and validated for framing, checksum, canonical parse, and chain continuity before restoration.

entries.definition_short: Authorized policy input used for local compatibility checks.
entries.definition_operational: Names the policy bundle used to verify authorized policy_id and local compatibility before restoration can be allowed.

entries.definition_short: Startup storage state before verification begins.
entries.definition_operational: Names the startup mount state that must be read-only before verification begins and remains part of the trusted restoration boundary.

entries.definition_short: Validated context assembled for handoff after ALLOW.
entries.definition_operational: Names the restored context handed to the execution layer only after ALLOW and complete replay from the verified head.

entries.definition_short: Mandatory prevention of persistent-state injection after a blocking failure.
entries.definition_operational: Names the mandatory blocking control that suppresses persistent-state injection after any blocking failure and keeps restoration fail-closed.
usage_constraints: Mandatory prevention of persistent-state injection after a blocking failure.

entries.definition_short: Controlled exit from fail-safe after recovery obligations and approval.
entries.definition_operational: Names the controlled exit from fail-safe after recovery obligations are satisfied and the required authority approves release.
usage_constraints: Controlled exit from fail-safe after recovery obligations are satisfied and the required authority approves release.

entries.definition_short: Gate that permits validated_context handoff.
entries.definition_operational: Names the gate that opens only when all critical validators PASS and verified context is assembled, allowing validated_context handoff.

entries.definition_short: Gate that suppresses restore when a critical failure is present.
entries.definition_operational: Names the gate that closes autonomous restore and suppresses injection while recovery proof and authority release are still absent.

entries.definition_short: Gate that isolates partial artefacts during recoverable ambiguity or tool restriction.
entries.definition_operational: Names the gate that isolates partial artefacts while separate closure conditions remain unsatisfied.

entries.definition_short: Gate that halts autonomous progress when the environment, policy, or authority is deficient.
entries.definition_operational: Names the gate that blocks autonomous progress until operator or policy-authority action resolves the deficiency.

entries.definition_short: Gate that controls exit from fail-safe.
entries.definition_operational: Names the gate that opens only after fail-safe entry and completion of the closure bundle, and remains closed if any obligation is missing.

entries.definition_short: Rule that limits restoration to the accepted head.
entries.definition_operational: Names the precedence rule and proof requirement that restoration may not extend beyond the accepted head and that an unanchored tail remains ineligible.
usage_constraints: The accepted-head-only rule prevails over any local continuity of an unanchored tail.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for the principal restoration rule.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that yields ALLOW when all critical validators PASS and yields DENY when a critical validator fails.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for freshness and policy acceptance of imported context.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that denies acceptance and restore when freshness is not strictly greater or policy is incompatible.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for accepted and visible head selection.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that denies restoration when IRR is invalid or visibility is unsatisfied and keeps the tail ineligible.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for tool-state release or isolation.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that quarantines tool-state when schema, allow-list, or approval requirements are not satisfied.

entries.definition_short: Decision object listed for controlled release from fail-safe.
entries.definition_operational: Names the fail-safe release decision object listed in the agent overview and bounded by the readmission controls and authority release path.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for authorized exit from fail-safe.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that transitions READMISSION_PENDING to ALLOW only after recovery obligations are satisfied and authority approves.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for recoverable WAL ambiguity.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that yields QUARANTINE when WAL phase ambiguity is recoverable and blocks release before convergence is proven.

entries.definition_short: Decision object for startup trustworthiness.
entries.definition_operational: Names the decision object that yields ESCALATE when boot mode is not read-only or the snapshot is unstable.

entries.definition_short: Final verdict emitted for restoration handling.
entries.definition_operational: Names the final verdict output that binds the restoration decision to validator results, head selection, snapshot context, and failure signaling.

entries.definition_short: Normative verdict permitting restoration.
entries.definition_operational: Means restoration may be executed only from the verified head and only for the context declared eligible.
usage_constraints: ALLOW means restoration may be executed only from the verified head and only for the context declared eligible.

entries.definition_short: Normative verdict blocking restoration.
entries.definition_operational: Means no persistent state is injected and the blocking reason remains explicit in the evidence and gate outputs.
usage_constraints: DENY means no persistent state is injected.

entries.definition_short: Normative verdict isolating artefacts or state portions.
entries.definition_operational: Means artefacts or state portions remain isolated and non-executable until the required closure conditions are met.
usage_constraints: QUARANTINE means artefacts or state portions remain isolated and non-executable.

entries.definition_short: Normative verdict requiring operator or policy-authority intervention.
entries.definition_operational: Means operator or policy-authority intervention is required because the verification environment, policy, or authority conditions are not trustworthy or not sufficient.
usage_constraints: ESCALATE means operator or policy-authority intervention is required.

entries.definition_short: Normative verdict showing fail-safe closure is still incomplete.
entries.definition_operational: Means a fail-safe state has not yet been closed through the required readmission conditions.

entries.definition_short: Verifies record framing structure and boundaries.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies record framing structure and boundaries and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: frame_status, frame_offset. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies frame checksum.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies frame checksum and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: checksum_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies unambiguous canonical parsing.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies unambiguous canonical parsing and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: parse_status, canonical_form_id. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies hash-chain continuity.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies hash-chain continuity and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: prior_digest, current_digest, chain_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies signatures and the permitted cryptographic profile.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies signatures and the permitted cryptographic profile and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: key_id, sig_status, alg_profile. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies strict increase against the local watermark.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies strict increase against the local watermark and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: source_id, accepted_freshness, candidate_freshness. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies policy_id and local policy compatibility.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies policy_id and local policy compatibility and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: policy_id, compat_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies deployment-policy compatibility.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies deployment-policy compatibility and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: deployment_profile, compat_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies IRR existence and validity.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies irr existence and validity and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: irr_digest, irr_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Selects only the accepted and visible head.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that selects only the accepted and visible head and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: accepted_head_digest. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies startup remount as read-only.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies startup remount as read-only and whose failure produces ESCALATE. Minimum evidence: mount_mode. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies binding to a stable snapshot.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies binding to a stable snapshot and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: snapshot_id, fd_binding_digest. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies coherence of PREPARE / ANCHOR / APPEND / COMMIT markers.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies coherence of prepare / anchor / append / commit markers and whose failure produces QUARANTINE. Minimum evidence: wal_phase. Severity: high.

entries.definition_short: Verifies counter monotonicity and continuity.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies counter monotonicity and continuity and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: counter_value, anchor_digest. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Verifies tool-state schema.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies tool-state schema and whose failure produces tool_quarantine. Minimum evidence: tool_schema_status. Severity: medium.

entries.definition_short: Verifies the allow-list and capability ceiling.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies the allow-list and capability ceiling and whose failure produces tool_quarantine. Minimum evidence: tool_id, allow_status. Severity: medium.

entries.definition_short: Verifies single-writer discipline.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies single-writer discipline and whose failure produces ESCALATE. Minimum evidence: writer_lock_status, contention_status. Severity: high.

entries.definition_short: Verifies the anti-rollback anchor.
entries.definition_operational: Names the validator that verifies the anti-rollback anchor and whose failure produces DENY. Minimum evidence: anchor_status. Severity: critical.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field binding the results of all validators.
entries.definition_operational: Identifies the bundle that binds the results of every critical validator and supports verdict emission and offline reconstruction.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying the verified head for replay.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the digest of the verified head used for replay, release, and accepted-head-only proof.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying the accepted and visible head.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the digest that proves accepted-head visibility and supports release-gate observability.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying the verification-time snapshot context.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the stable snapshot identifier used to bind verification, replay, and offline reconstruction to the same snapshot context.
usage_constraints: Replay uses only the same snapshot context in which the head was validated.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying the locally applied policy.
entries.definition_operational: Names the policy identifier used in compatibility checks and recorded in the verdict evidence bundle.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field linking the decision to valid reception.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the digest that links the restoration decision to valid IRR handling and accepted intake.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field explaining denial or escalation.
entries.definition_operational: Provides the explicit failure code used to explain DENY or ESCALATE and to keep blocking decisions observable and reconstructable.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field separating restoration from tool-state activation.
entries.definition_operational: Shows whether tool-state activation remains inactive, quarantined, or otherwise separately gated from conversational restoration.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field showing WAL recovery and convergence state.
entries.definition_operational: Shows the current recovery phase so that convergence, replay sufficiency, and readmission control remain observable.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field showing single-writer enforcement at relevant control points.
entries.definition_operational: Shows writer-lock and contention state so that single-writer discipline remains observable during restore and mutation control.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying the source under freshness evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: Names the source identifier used in freshness verification and in machine-readable restore requests.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field recording source freshness in the minimum bundle.
entries.definition_operational: Names the freshness value used to track source freshness in the minimum evidence bundle for the principal verdict.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field naming the validator that failed.
entries.definition_operational: Names the failed validator used to explain DENY or ESCALATE and to preserve explicit failure reasons.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field recording suppression handling after blocking failure.
entries.definition_operational: Names the suppression status carried with denial signaling and fail-safe handling after a blocking failure.

entries.definition_short: Evidence field identifying readmission token issuance where applicable.
entries.definition_operational: Names the readmission token identifier carried in the minimum evidence bundle when readmission token issuance is applicable.

entries.definition_short: Storage remounted read-only; no restore permitted.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which storage remounted read-only; no restore permitted. Exit condition: Snapshot locked.

entries.definition_short: Stable verification context established.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which stable verification context established. Exit condition: Structural validation finished.

entries.definition_short: Framing, checksum, parse, chain, and signature validation succeeded.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which framing, checksum, parse, chain, and signature validation succeeded. Exit condition: Policy, freshness, IRR, and visibility verified.

entries.definition_short: Accepted visible head fixed.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which accepted visible head fixed. Exit condition: Replay completed.

entries.definition_short: Validated context assembled.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which validated context assembled. Exit condition: ALLOW emitted.

entries.definition_short: Persistent context suppressed.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which persistent context suppressed. Exit condition: Authorized recovery path starts.

entries.definition_short: Tool-state isolated.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which tool-state isolated. Exit condition: Separate approval or discard.

entries.definition_short: WAL or continuity replay in progress.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which wal or continuity replay in progress. Exit condition: Convergence proven.

entries.definition_short: Fail-safe exit under controlled authority.
entries.definition_operational: Names the workflow state in which fail-safe exit under controlled authority. Exit condition: All obligations satisfied.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S0 STARTUP_READONLY to S1 SNAPSHOT_LOCKED.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S0 STARTUP_READONLY to S1 SNAPSHOT_LOCKED when the guard V_BOOT_MODE PASS is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE or ESCALATE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S1 SNAPSHOT_LOCKED to S2 STRUCTURAL_VERIFIED.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S1 SNAPSHOT_LOCKED to S2 STRUCTURAL_VERIFIED when the guard V_SNAPSHOT PASS is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S2 STRUCTURAL_VERIFIED to S3 ELIGIBLE_HEAD_SELECTED.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S2 STRUCTURAL_VERIFIED to S3 ELIGIBLE_HEAD_SELECTED when the guard V_FRAME..V_SIG PASS is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S3 ELIGIBLE_HEAD_SELECTED to S4 REHYDRATED_VALIDATED.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S3 ELIGIBLE_HEAD_SELECTED to S4 REHYDRATED_VALIDATED when the guard V_FRESHNESS + V_POLICY + V_IRR + V_VISIBILITY PASS is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from Any state to S5 FAIL_SAFE.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from Any state to S5 FAIL_SAFE when the guard V_ANCHOR or V_COUNTER_CONT FAIL is satisfied. On failure: QUARANTINE + ESCALATE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from Recovery path to S7 RECOVERY_REPLAY.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from Recovery path to S7 RECOVERY_REPLAY when the guard V_WAL_PHASE indicates recovery is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S7 RECOVERY_REPLAY to S8 READMISSION_PENDING.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S7 RECOVERY_REPLAY to S8 READMISSION_PENDING when the guard No duplicate effects is satisfied. On failure: S5 FAIL_SAFE.

entries.definition_short: Trigger in the transition model from S8 READMISSION_PENDING to S0 STARTUP_READONLY.
entries.definition_operational: Names the trigger that moves the workflow from S8 READMISSION_PENDING to S0 STARTUP_READONLY when the guard Readmission approved is satisfied. On failure: Remain blocked.

entries.definition_short: Write-ahead log used for recovery ordering and phase control.
entries.definition_operational: Names the write-ahead log whose phase ordering prevails during recovery and whose ambiguity can force QUARANTINE until convergence is proven.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for restoration requests.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable restoration request form whose canonical fields are request_id, source_id, requested_head, and policy_profile.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for validator results.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable form that carries validator_id, status, evidence_ref, and timestamp_or_counter.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for the final verdict.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable verdict form whose canonical fields are verdict, verified_head_digest, snapshot_id, and failure_code.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for tool-state isolation.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable form for tool-state isolation whose canonical fields are tool_id, schema_status, allow_status, and quarantine_scope.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for exit from fail-safe.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable readmission form whose canonical fields are token_id, approver_set, and satisfied_obligations.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable form for auditable validation execution.
entries.definition_operational: Names the machine-readable validation log whose canonical fields are validation_run_id, test_id, axis, status, evidence_ref, and reviewer.

entries.definition_short: Optional separate gate for tool-state activation.
entries.definition_operational: Names an optional feature whose absence leaves conversational restoration valid while tool-state remains inactive.

entries.definition_short: Policy-dependent but recommended readmission control.
entries.definition_operational: Names an optional readmission arrangement that, if absent, requires the readmission rule to be explicitly narrowed.

entries.definition_short: Optional supplementary control for continuity evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: Names an optional supplementary control that may not substitute for mandatory validators.
usage_constraints: It may not substitute for mandatory validators.

entries.definition_short: Optional performance-only control.
entries.definition_operational: Names optional indices that may exist for performance reasons but do not affect acceptance or restoration.
usage_constraints: They do not affect acceptance or restoration.
